device_overview.product_code_desc: Device model code (Critical!): Can be used to determine the specific device model.
device_overview.serial_number_fb_desc: Device unique serial number: Unique identifier for each device, used to distinguish different devices, similar to 'Device ID'.
device_overview.boot_method_desc: Device boot method: Uses UEFI boot (mainstream method for modern Android devices, replacing traditional BIOS), affects bootloader compatibility.
device_overview.max_download_size_desc: Fastboot max download size: Image files flashed via fastboot cannot exceed this size (prevents transfer errors).
device_overview.parallel_flash_desc: Support parallel flashing: Can flash multiple partition images simultaneously (e.g., boot and dtbo at the same time), improving flashing speed.
device_overview.off_mode_charge_desc: Off-mode charging: Indicates whether 'charging screen when powered off' is enabled (customizable on some devices), 1 means enabled.
device_overview.fb_unlock_status_desc: Bootloader unlocked (Critical!): Indicates the device is unlocked and supports flashing third-party ROMs, recovery, etc.; Locked status cannot modify system底层.
device_overview.fb_secure_boot_desc: Secure boot enabled: Indicates the device has Secure Boot enabled, only allows verified system images (e.g., official ROM) to boot; If you need to flash third-party images, you may need to disable it (supported on some devices).
device_overview.fb_anti_rollback_desc: Anti-rollback protection: Indicates anti-rollback is enabled, prohibits flashing bootloader / baseband with lower version numbers, avoiding downgrade vulnerabilities.
device_overview.fb_current_mode_desc: Current mode: Indicates being in pure bootloader low-level mode (Android user space not loaded), user space mode is rare.
device_overview.fb_slot_count_desc: Partition slot count: Indicates support for A/B dual slots (A slot: _a partition, B slot: _b partition).
device_overview.fb_active_slot_desc: Current active slot: Device currently boots using A slot (_a partition), if A slot fails, it will automatically switch to B slot.
device_overview.fb_hw_version_desc: Hardware version number: Distinguishes device hardware batches (e.g., different factories, different component versions), different hardware versions may affect ROM compatibility.
device_overview.fb_battery_voltage_desc: Current battery voltage: Unit is mV (millivolts), belongs to normal battery voltage range (full charge about 4.4-4.5V), indicates battery is currently supplying power normally.
device_overview.fb_battery_status_desc: Battery status: Indicates battery is sufficient (usually > 20%), meets flashing / operation requirements; if battery is too low, cannot perform low-level operations.
device_overview.fb_cpuid_desc: CPU unique ID: Unique identifier for identifying device CPU chip, used to distinguish different CPU batches (generally used for debugging).
